title.zh: 将 LLM 个体决策接入群体生存闭环
title.en: Integrate LLM Individual Decisions into Population Survival Loop

intent.zh: 让模型在个体真实可行行动候选中结合人格、需求、记忆和群体环境作出选择，同时保持硬约束、限额、并发与规则回退，并可审计模型来源。
intent.en: Let a model choose among each individual's feasible actions using personality, needs, memory and group context while preserving hard constraints, bounded concurrency, deterministic fallback and auditable provenance.

acceptance: LLM population mode can select feasible actions for a rotating subset of residents with bounded concurrency.
Prompts include individual memories, survival needs, shared resources, population and recent group action context.
Invalid model output falls back to deterministic rule decisions and records provenance; default mode remains off.
Focused AI/config/runtime/decision tests pass; no unrelated working-tree edits are committed.
note: 已将 LLM 个体选择接入 loop 的真实决策环：population 模式按存活居民轮换采样，有限并发，提示词包含个体记忆/需求/群体资源/近期群体行动；模型只能在硬约束候选集内选择，非法输出 fail-soft 回退规则并记录 provider/model/latency/context/provenance。默认 off；默认 gateway 仍为确定性 stub，真实 LLM 需显式注册 a6api/local 等 provider。定向测试66/66通过，node --check 与 git diff --check通过。Normify repoRoot 校验0 errors；保留297条未锚定依赖与Viewer叶子过粗warning。
